decision: 11_DEPLOYMENT §6 and ADR-024: list every APP_HOST service process that opens a PostgreSQL pool. nexloop-doctor --budget-only sums pool max x process count (<= 60) and requires the server's max_connections >= 80 before any service starts. Process counts follow 11_DEPLOYMENT §7; adjust this file together with the service configuration. NX-031 D7: every background service (nexloop_eios.background_services, one single-loop process each) is listed with its pool (POOL_MAX 2), and the plan-reevaluator and reply-guarantor launchers with their second nexloop_api pool (API_POOL_MAX 2: measured, a launch needs two connections). To stay within 60 the domain-worker (one bounded Artifact maintenance page per run, domain_worker.POOL_MAX) is declared with 2.
